remarks: Your opportunity to own one of the coveted two bedroom units with a terrace! Two generously sized bedrooms with roomy closets, large living/dining area all with hardwood floors. Kitchen with tile floor and backsplash, granite counters and stainless steel appliances has gas range. Full bath has tile floor. The screened terrace is located directly off the living room. Located in vibrant downtown Stamford with all it has to offer! Close to public transportation and a quick commute to NYC.  This well maintained, secure building offers an elevator, common laundry area, community room, and on or off street parking in it's generously sized parking lot. Professionally managed, and great news...common charges include taxes! Unit must be owner occupied, no rentals and no pets. If desired, owners may request to be placed on waiting list for a garage space, for which there is a fee.
